title: [BUG] [alpha] MergeEditor CodeLens conflict matching by label misplaces actions
summary: CodeLens locates conflict line by oursLabel text only; repeated labels (for example multiple HEAD conflicts) map to first match and misplace actions.
steps: Open merge content with at least two unresolved conflicts sharing same oursLabel.
Observe second conflict actions anchor to first matching label line.
expected: Each conflict should map CodeLens by conflict identity or exact marker position.
actual: Label-only matching maps duplicate labels to the first marker line.
